name: app-lime-subscription-plans-screen-and-in-car-ride-screen
title: Black-and-white pricing drawer with lime button beside an in-car hand-held active ride screen
whatItIs: Two dark panels: left a phone with a black header 'Premium Plan' and a white drawer listing three plans with the middle plan black with lime price, and a wide lime Subscribe button; right a photo of a hand holding a phone inside a car with a dark road screen, a white ETA sheet with lime stats and a lime progress pill.
whatItMeans: Confident and clear; one active tier and one lime button make the choice simple.
techniques: Split screen into black hero and white drawer.
Invert the selected plan to black.
Show the app in its real context (inside a car).

vocabulary.definition: A device photographed in its use setting.
A small bar showing trip progress.
